# OpenZync

> Open-source graph-based memory infrastructure for AI agents — persistent memory built as a temporal knowledge graph where facts supersede rather than overwrite, exposed over REST API and MCP.

## Docs

- [Documentation](https://docs.openzync.tech/en/latest/): full documentation
- [Quickstart](https://docs.openzync.tech/en/latest/guides/quickstart.html): get running fast
- [Memory & context](https://docs.openzync.tech/en/latest/domains/memory_context.html): how OpenZync models agent memory

## Code

- [openzync-core](https://github.com/openzync/openzync-core): FastAPI backend monolith — REST API, graph storage, workers
- [openzync-python-sdk](https://github.com/openzync/openzync-python-sdk): Python SDK, published to PyPI as `openzync`
- [openzync-mcp](https://github.com/openzync/openzync-mcp): FastMCP server exposing OpenZync memory to agents
